contents.name: authorities

components.name: Create
components.element:
{(translate => <Create>
 <TabbedForm>
  <FormTab label={translate('resources.user.tabs.general')}>
   <TextInput source="id" validate={[required(), useUniqId()]}/>
   <PasswordInput source="password" validate={[minLength(5)]}/>
  </FormTab>
  <FormTab label={translate('resources.user.tabs.tags')}>
   <ArrayInput source="tags" label="">
    <SimpleFormIterator inline getItemLabel={() => ''}>
     <SelectInput source="name" choices={settings.user.tags.map(tag => ({id: tag, name: translate(`resources.user.tags.${tag}`)}))} validate={[required()]}/>
     <DateTimeInput source="start"/>
     <DateTimeInput source="end"/>
    </SimpleFormIterator>
   </ArrayInput>
  </FormTab>
 </TabbedForm>
</Create>)(useTranslate())}

components.name: Edit
components.element:
{(translate => <Edit>
 <TabbedForm>
  <FormTab label={translate('resources.user.tabs.general')}>
   <Labeled>
    <FunctionField source="updatedAt" render={() => <><DateField showTime source="updatedAt"/> <TextField source="updatedBy"/></>}/>
   </Labeled>
   <PasswordInput source="password" validate={[minLength(5)]}/>
  </FormTab>
  <FormTab label={translate('resources.user.tabs.tags')}>
   <ArrayInput source="tags" label="">
    <SimpleFormIterator inline getItemLabel={() => ''}>
     <SelectInput source="name" choices={settings.user.tags.map(tag => ({id: tag, name: translate(`resources.user.tags.${tag}`)}))} validate={[required()]}/>
     <DateTimeInput source="start"/>
     <DateTimeInput source="end"/>
    </SimpleFormIterator>
   </ArrayInput>
  </FormTab>
 </TabbedForm>
</Edit>)(useTranslate())}

components.name: List
components.element:
{(translate => <List filters={[
 <TextInput source="id" alwaysOn/>,
 <ParseInput component={SelectInput} source="tags" parse={value => `{name: '${value}'}`} choices={settings.user.tags.map(tag => ({id: tag, name: translate(`resources.user.tags.${tag}`)}))} label={translate('resources.user.tabs.tags')}/>
]} exporter={false}>
 <Datagrid rowClick={false}>
  <TextField source="id"/>
  <ArrayField source="tags" label={translate('resources.user.tabs.tags')}>
   <SingleFieldList linkType={false}>
    <FunctionField render={({name}) => <Chip size="small" label={translate(`resources.user.tags.${name}`)}/>}/>
   </SingleFieldList>
  </ArrayField>
  <EditButton/>
 </Datagrid>
</List>)(useTranslate())}
